title: Provider profiles
summary: Select the provider connection, model and request settings for a session without changing the agent's instructions.

workflows.label: Choose a profile
workflows.summary: Browse and activate a configured loadout before starting work.

entry.prerequisite: Open Session Options with the sliders button beside + in the sidebar.

steps.action: Open Session Options → Model and choose a configured model/profile before starting a session.
Use Manage Profiles to inspect its provider, endpoint, model and reasoning effort.
steps.expect: The profile name is a label; the endpoint determines where requests go.

steps.action: Select Start Session after checking the agent and workspace.
steps.expect: Changing the provider setup does not change the agent’s role or instructions.

commands.description: Browse and switch loadouts; /llm <name> activates a named loadout and /llm new opens creation.
commands.expect: The active loadout supplies the session's provider, model and parameters.

commands.description: Start Kollab with the named profile selected for this launch.
commands.expect: The selected profile is used for the session.

media.alt: Kollab provider profile settings showing provider and model choices
media.caption: Check provider, endpoint and model before activating a profile.

workflows.success: The session uses the selected provider connection and model.

recovery.symptom: The loadout is not listed or the provider cannot authenticate
recovery.action: Check /llm and the provider's sign-in or environment setup; authenticate separately on this computer.

recovery.symptom: A saved active profile is missing
recovery.action: Select an available loadout with /llm or restore the missing profile configuration.

workflows.note: A profile chooses the provider connection and model; it does not select an agent or change the agent's prompt.

workflows.label: Copy a profile
workflows.summary: Keep a connection’s stored configuration while giving the copy its own name.

steps.action: Choose Copy on the source profile, then enter a name for the copy.
Check the provider, base URL/endpoint, model and reasoning effort, then choose Copy Profile.
steps.expect: Stored fields not shown in the form, including an ACP command, are preserved.

steps.action: If its key came from KOLLAB_<PROFILE>_API_KEY or KOLLAB_API_KEY, securely set a profile-specific key for the copy or sign in again.
steps.expect: Environment-sourced and provisioned keys do not move; stored keyring/sign-in references are retained.

workflows.success: The new profile keeps the source’s stored connection settings and can be selected separately.

recovery.action: Check its own sign-in or KOLLAB_<PROFILE>_API_KEY. Do not paste credentials into chat or Hub messages.

workflows.note: Copying retains stored ACP command, working directory, workspace, environment and install guidance. Verify the endpoint before using the copy.

workflows.label: Use an environment profile
workflows.summary: Set a profile's provider and credentials in your shell environment, then launch that profile.

entry.prerequisite: Have an API key from your provider and keep it out of shared messages and source files.

steps.action: In your shell, export the profile-specific provider and key, for example KOLLAB_WORK_PROVIDER=openai and KOLLAB_WORK_API_KEY=$OPENAI_API_KEY.
Launch with kollab --llm work and confirm the profile's provider, model and endpoint are the ones you intended.
If you copy a profile, check its endpoint and set up its own environment key or sign-in; copied profiles do not receive environment-sourced or provisioned keys.

commands.example: export KOLLAB_WORK_PROVIDER=openai && export KOLLAB_WORK_API_KEY=$OPENAI_API_KEY && kollab --llm work
commands.description: Provide a named profile's provider and credentials through environment variables. Avoid putting real credentials in command history; export them securely in your shell instead.
commands.expect: Kollab resolves the named environment profile for the session.

workflows.success: Kollab can resolve the named profile without storing its secret in a chat message.

recovery.symptom: Authentication fails after copying a profile
recovery.action: Sign in on this computer or securely provide the copied profile's own KOLLAB_<NAME>_API_KEY; environment and provisioned keys are not transferred.
Inspect the profile's provider and base URL in settings before starting a session.
